execution.description: Ran the registered 48-case counted GetDP campaign for the motor decision study, then imported and evaluated it; the registered importer refused every successful case, and study V2 adopted the campaign after proving identical decisions.

expected: The registered importer would admit the 48 successful cases as counted evidence and produce a finite-set comparator and regret for the four arms.
observed: 48/48 cases were OK, but the V1 importer marked every one REFERENCE_PROVENANCE_INVALID because it required non-empty log.mesh and log.getdp, and the pinned solver writes empty logs on success. #562 had fixture tests only, and no test had ever run the counted importer. Study V2 relaxed only that rule; its construction made decisions identical to V1's commitments sealed before dispatch, so it adopted the campaign. The comparator is complete (4 feasible, 4 infeasible, best d04). The analytical arms chose an infeasible design; the KRR arms chose d06 with regret 0.0192.
keep: Hash and write-protect raw evidence before diagnosing an import failure, and never edit records or artifacts to pass an importer.
When a fix must change frozen code, ship a new study version and prove the new construction's decisions equal the sealed predecessor's before adopting its reference.
change: Exercise every counted importer against at least one real solver case (calibration output is enough) before a counted campaign is dispatched; a fixture-only importer can refuse all real evidence.
